interactions.name: Same markup, different identity: every proof screen renders identical DOM in Nasaq and Liwan
Contract: Nasaq and Liwan are accepted in light and dark; v3, brass, fayrouz stay accepted; invalid stays rejected
D1: amounts use physical right alignment with tabular figures in V3 (no A/B switch)
Navigation model per window class holds in both identities (bottom bar · rail · sidebar)
Dashboard: quick action opens a sales invoice; attention action opens the shift; cash chart has a data-table alternative
Long invoice (80 lines): count, sticky header inside its own scroller, find filters without losing data
Errors keep the typed data: line-numbered summary, "with errors" filter, link focuses the field inside the scroller
A correction link to a line hidden by "find in lines" clears the find and focuses the field
Recovery keeps the last saved draft: discard after reload returns to the save, not to a blank invoice
Keyboard actions update recovery: Ctrl+S survives a reload with no "unsaved" notice; Alt+N line survives a reload
Enter in a filtered invoice skips hidden rows; Enter on the last visible row adds a visible, focused line
"With errors" filter keeps the row being corrected visible until the field is left
"Add line" and Alt+N under find / error filter add a visible, focused line (no hidden lines)
Navigation icons: every item has its own approved icon, drawn (no missing symbol), identical in sidebar, mobile sheet and tablet group sheet
Navigation icons: an item without an icon, or with an unknown one, keeps its group icon (EXT.nav compatibility)
Mobile menu sheet: 44px rows, current item revealed below the sticky header, every item reachable, bottom bar unchanged
One icon family: rail groups, create sheet and dashboard quick actions draw the approved Lucide shapes, the same as the menu for the same meaning
Sidebar keeps its scroll position across re-renders, and a route change brings the current item into view
Mobile menu: quick access one tap away (≥ 44px, current marked, labelled «وصول سريع»), full group order below unchanged
Phone density: invoice line cards in three columns, inventory and invoice cards in paired rows, amounts never clipped or wrapped
An active line search keeps its field when deletions bring the invoice to ten lines or fewer
"#app" from the compare view shows the app, not a blank page
Phone KPI labels: short (one line at 390, never cut below), no abbreviated tax term, «payable» in the note, full labels for screen readers; desktop unchanged
Tablet rail: every group name is readable in full (wraps, never cut)
Phone «needs attention»: an item without an amount keeps its action beside the text; targets ≥ 44px; nothing overflows
Long invoice keeps its line-scroll position when a line is deleted
Draft vs post is explicit: lifecycle captions, draft note, Save draft keeps the document editable
Unsaved changes survive a reload: local recovery notice restores the typed values; discard returns to the last save
Explorer compare view loads both identities side by side for the same screen and state
Mobile ergonomics: at 390px every action in the main area is ≥ 44px tall in both identities
Reduced motion: no transitions on controls in either identity
